description: Top-level MJML email template editor. Combines a task-grouped command bar (history, review, file, help, host slots, save-status badge and save) with a three-pane layout: a block toolbox, a drag-and-drop canvas and a property panel for the selected element. The host reports every save outcome through OnSave and the editor owns the dirty state (IsDirty/IsDirtyChanged), IsSaving, ReadOnly and the single-flight save queue; SaveAsync() is public for a TmNavigationGuard.OnSaveAndLeave wiring.

parameters.name: AutoSave
parameters.description: Auto-save configuration; when enabled, edits are saved after a debounce interval.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Gets or sets the edited document. Two-way bindable via DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: FooterActions
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the preview dialog footer — for example "Send test email". The editor never sends anything itself; the host owns that action and its result.

parameters.name: ImageUpload
parameters.description: Client-side limits (Accept, MaxBytes) applied to a picked image before OnImageUpload is called. null uses the defaults (5 MB, images only).

parameters.name: IsDirtyChanged
parameters.description: Raised when IsDirty changes — only on a transition, never on initialization and never for an edit that keeps the document dirty.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Optional host image-upload handler: receives a picked file, returns the hosted URL.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a save.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Disables every editing path (toolbox, canvas drag&drop and inline actions, inspector inputs, import, undo/redo and the shortcuts that mutate the document) while keeping preview, validation and export available. SaveAsync returns a failed result without calling the host. The component never changes this value itself.

parameters.name: ShowSaveButton
parameters.description: Whether the Save button is rendered. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ShowSaveStatus
parameters.description: Whether the save-status badge is rendered. Defaults to true; the badge announces unsaved changes, the in-flight save, the relative time of the last confirmed save, a failure with the host's message and a conflict.

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: Clock used for auto-save debouncing (overridable in tests).

parameters.name: ToolbarEnd
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the command bar, before the save chrome.

parameters.name: ToolbarStart
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the start of the command bar (back, title, …).

parameters.name: ToolboxCollapsed
parameters.description: Whether the blocks palette is collapsed. The editor mirrors the state it is given and reports every toggle through ToolboxCollapsedChanged; F8 maps the same parameter onto TmEditorShell.CollapsedPanels (D10).

parameters.name: ToolboxCollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new state when the user collapses or expands the blocks palette. Bind it back into ToolboxCollapsed for a controlled palette; without a binding the palette toggles on its own (seeded from the parameter).

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Host-provided variables offered by the variable picker (merged with extracted ones).
